captions.detailed: This 3D model features a solar hydrogen-alpha refractor telescope mounted on a black alt-azimuth tripod. The main optical tube is colored a distinct solar red, which connects to a golden-orange cylindrical etalon filter, followed by a silver-metallic prismatic focuser drawtube and a black eyepiece. The telescope body is cradled in a black alt-azimuth mount that allows the optical tube to tilt vertically via an altitude joint, while the entire arm assembly rotates horizontally on a thick cylindrical azimuth bearing atop a tripod stand with three thin, angled legs.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a solar hydrogen-alpha refractor telescope on an alt-azimuth tripod mount. The telescope should feature a red main tube, a golden-orange etalon cylinder, a silver drawtube, and a black eyepiece, with functional joints enabling horizontal azimuth rotation and vertical altitude tilt.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining five distinct parts: tripod, mount_base, fork, telescope, and focuser. The tripod is built using a central cylinder and three angled rectangular box legs. The mount_base utilizes stacked cylinders to form the azimuth bearing, connected to the tripod via a continuous joint. The fork is created with a central block and two vertical side plates. The telescope tube is modeled as a main red cylinder, which connects to the fork via a revolute altitude joint. Finally, the focuser is made of concentric cylinders (representing the etalon, drawtube, and eyepiece) and is attached to the telescope body through a prismatic draw-tube joint.
